📅 How to Use the Book

1
Before You Start

Get a journal or notebook

Every chapter ends with reflection exercises. You need somewhere to write. A cheap notebook works perfectly.

2
Weekly

Read one chapter per week — no skipping

The book has 12 chapters arranged across 3 steps. One chapter a week. Read it slowly, not in one rush. Let it sit.

3
Daily

Do the 30-day daily mindset practice

10 minutes a day. Use the daily practice guide built into the programme. Consistency here is what creates the rewiring.

4
End of Each Chapter

Complete every journal exercise — don't skip them

The journal exercises are where the real work happens. Reading without writing is like going to the gym and watching others lift.

5
Week 2 Especially

Pay extra attention to the Belief Flip chapter

This is the chapter readers say changed them most. Take your time on it. Do the belief flip exercise twice if you need to.
